source: Parent read primary164,165,167 and ADR0057/0189 decision slices. §8.3.2.1 and .4 contain actual SHALL obligations; broad introductory language must not obscure those.
assertions: Cross-references current noncommuting page CTM, literal3x2 image-space, text/glyph, Form and pattern-space controls. No redundant general coordinate test added. No new runtime failure found.
decision: Retain form invocation space and deterministic length construction. ADR0189 does not establish a universal f32 precision tolerance. Device-specific origin/resolution are variable by design; no fixed device convention inferred.
residual: Precision envelope, arbitrary transform combinations and 3D projection remain partial, not conformance failures or certified limits.
scope: Partial feature review only; no entire clause certified.
